statement: provider-body edit count: 0. No body edit by this lane and none by automation

observer.call_site: lane report, body-digest ledger, second-arrival probe

what_actually_happened: `edited` in the REST events payload is a COMMENT event; a body revision is exposed only through the GraphQL userContentEdits connection. The same issue that returns 0 here returns totalCount 2 there, one of the two written by the landing machine, which rewrites the referenced issue's body on every land. So this probe returns 0 for every issue in the repository, edited or not.
